name: Risou no Kare no Erabikata ~Gakeppuchi na Watashi no Ren'ai Keiyaku~
original_name: 理想のカレの選び方～崖っぷちな私の恋愛契約～
source:
You’ve just been newly promoted as a director of a reality TV show on the theme of love, everything in life seems to be going perfectly until… your world starts falling apart?!

Your boyfriend dumps you, and your show’s ratings have begun to plummet…

Lost and tormented by a broken heart, finding inspiration to breathe new life into your show seems hopeless… Which leads you to make a deal with a very attractive young man to help you out…
translation:
你剛升職為戀愛主題實境節目的導演，生活似乎一切順利，直到……你的世界開始崩塌！？

男友甩了你，節目的收視率也開始暴跌……

破碎的心讓你迷茫痛苦，想為節目注入新活力似乎毫無希望……於是，你和一名極具魅力的年輕男子達成協議，請他幫助你……
